decks.domain: Illinois road signs warnings work zones

cards.front: Complete the rule: A stop-here-on-red sign identifies the stopping location at.
cards.back: A stop-here-on-red sign identifies the stopping location at a signal-controlled intersection when that location would otherwise be unclear.
cards.memory_hook: Stop here sign locates required red

cards.front: Complete the rule: A road-closed sign means the road is closed.
cards.back: A road-closed sign means the road is closed to all traffic and cannot be used to continue the trip.
cards.memory_hook: Road closed means no continuation

cards.front: Complete the rule: A do-not-pass sign prohibits overtaking and can accompany.
cards.back: A do-not-pass sign prohibits overtaking and can accompany yellow no-passing pavement lines on a two-way two-lane road.
cards.memory_hook: Do not pass sign prohibits overtaking

cards.front: Complete the rule: A pass-with-care sign marks the end of a.
cards.back: A pass-with-care sign marks the end of a no-passing zone but permits passing only when it is safe.
cards.memory_hook: End of restriction still requires safe

cards.front: Complete the rule: A bicycle lane is marked by a solid.
cards.back: A bicycle lane is marked by a solid white boundary changing to a dotted line before the corner, and it may be painted bright green for visibility.
cards.memory_hook: Bicycle lane markings can change near

cards.front: Complete the rule: Warning signs usually use a diamond shape for.
cards.back: Warning signs usually use a diamond shape for hazards or special conditions; ordinary warnings are commonly yellow, work warnings orange and some school or crossing warnings yellow-green.
cards.memory_hook: Warning signs identify special conditions

cards.front: Complete the rule: A crosswalk warning calls for checking both.
cards.back: A crosswalk warning calls for checking both roadsides because crossings can occur away from intersections.
cards.memory_hook: Crosswalk may be between intersections

cards.front: Complete the rule: A yellow flashing beacon on a crossing sign.
cards.back: A yellow flashing beacon on a crossing sign helps alert drivers to the crosswalk and possible pedestrians.
cards.memory_hook: Crossing beacon increases driver awareness

cards.front: Complete the rule: School signs call for watching for children, slowing.
cards.back: School signs call for watching for children, slowing and stopping when needed; authorized crossing guards or police may supervise the crossing.
cards.memory_hook: School warning calls for readiness to

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook’s reduced-school-speed signs may apply when children.
cards.back: The handbook’s reduced-school-speed signs may apply when children are present on school days, when nearby children create a hazard or when a warning light flashes, with posted hours potentially varying.
cards.memory_hook: Follow school sign conditions and posted

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop-ahead, yield-ahead and signal-ahead warnings require beginning to.
cards.back: Stop-ahead, yield-ahead and signal-ahead warnings require beginning to slow even when the actual control is not yet visible.
cards.memory_hook: Advance control warning means prepare now

cards.front: Complete the rule: High-speed roads use advance warnings because.
cards.back: High-speed roads use advance warnings because slowing or stopping requires more distance.
cards.memory_hook: Higher speed needs earlier warning

cards.front: Complete the rule: Intersection-warning signs identify crossings or junctions where traffic.
cards.back: Intersection-warning signs identify crossings or junctions where traffic may enter or a turn may be needed.
cards.memory_hook: Junction warning prepares for intersecting traffic

cards.front: Complete the rule: The arrow on a turn or curve warning.
cards.back: The arrow on a turn or curve warning describes the approaching road direction, and an additional small panel may show the maximum safe speed.
cards.memory_hook: Read direction and advisory speed together

cards.front: Complete the rule: An exit-ramp speed sign identifies.
cards.back: An exit-ramp speed sign identifies the ramp’s maximum safe driving speed.
cards.memory_hook: Ramp speed warning applies to ramp

cards.front: Complete the rule: A slippery-pavement warning calls for slowing because wet.
cards.back: A slippery-pavement warning calls for slowing because wet pavement can cause lost control and lengthen stopping distance.
cards.memory_hook: Wet pavement increases stopping needs

decks.domain: Illinois road signs warnings work zones

cards.front: Complete the rule: A downgrade sign warns of a potentially long.
cards.back: A downgrade sign warns of a potentially long, steep or curving descent, so reduce speed before starting downhill.
cards.memory_hook: Slow before descending dangerous grade

cards.front: Complete the rule: A narrow-bridge warning identifies an approaching.
cards.back: A narrow-bridge warning identifies an approaching bridge with a narrower road surface.
cards.memory_hook: Bridge warning means reduced width ahead

cards.front: Complete the rule: A lane-reduction warning indicates fewer lanes ahead, temporarily.
cards.back: A lane-reduction warning indicates fewer lanes ahead, temporarily or permanently, requiring preparation to change lanes or admit merging vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: Fewer lanes require merging preparation

cards.front: Complete the rule: When traffic is light near a lane.
cards.back: When traffic is light near a lane reduction, merge into the open lane early.
cards.memory_hook: Light traffic permits early merge

cards.front: Complete the rule: In congestion near a lane reduction, use both.
cards.back: In congestion near a lane reduction, use both lanes to the merge point and alternate entries there, a method called zipper merging.
cards.memory_hook: Congestion uses alternating merge at lane

cards.front: Complete the rule: A road-narrows sign warns that.
cards.back: A road-narrows sign warns that a two-lane road becomes narrower abruptly.
cards.memory_hook: Narrowing warning calls for adjustment

cards.front: Complete the rule: The no-passing pennant appears on the road’s.
cards.back: The no-passing pennant appears on the road’s left where a two-lane two-way no-passing zone starts.
cards.memory_hook: Left pennant starts passing restriction

cards.front: Complete the rule: A merge warning means same-direction lanes will become.
cards.back: A merge warning means same-direction lanes will become one, so prepare either to change lanes or to allow another vehicle into the lane.
cards.memory_hook: Merge warning needs cooperative adjustment

decks.domain: Illinois road signs warnings work zones

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook advises an expressway driver to.
cards.back: The handbook advises an expressway driver to slow enough to let a ramp vehicle merge.
cards.memory_hook: Expressway driver helps ramp entry

cards.front: Complete the rule: A change-in-direction warning can mark a sharp curve.
cards.back: A change-in-direction warning can mark a sharp curve or a narrowing approach such as a narrow bridge.
cards.memory_hook: Direction warning identifies alignment change

cards.front: Complete the rule: A divided road uses a center strip to.
cards.back: A divided road uses a center strip to separate opposing traffic, with warnings before its beginning and before its end.
cards.memory_hook: Divided road signs mark separation changes

cards.front: Complete the rule: A two-way-roadway warning indicates departure from a.
cards.back: A two-way-roadway warning indicates departure from a divided roadway toward a highway carrying opposing traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Expect opposing traffic after divided road

cards.front: Complete the rule: Workers-ahead signs provide advance notice to adjust speed.
cards.back: Workers-ahead signs provide advance notice to adjust speed, follow the posted work limit, stay alert and leave room beside barriers.
cards.memory_hook: Workers ahead warning requires speed and

cards.front: Complete the rule: Cones, drums and barricades mark a path through.
cards.back: Cones, drums and barricades mark a path through construction or maintenance areas and warn of hazards.
cards.memory_hook: Temporary devices guide a safe path

cards.front: Complete the rule: Warning lights make drums and.
cards.back: Warning lights make drums and barriers easier to notice at night.
cards.memory_hook: Warning lights identify nighttime barriers

cards.front: Complete the rule: Arrow boards warn of an upcoming closure or.
cards.back: Arrow boards warn of an upcoming closure or work-zone caution and show the direction to move or merge.
cards.memory_hook: Arrow board guides movement near closure

decks.domain: Illinois road signs warnings work zones

cards.front: Complete the rule: A flagger warning calls for slowing, careful approach.
cards.back: A flagger warning calls for slowing, careful approach and compliance with the flagger’s instructions, including a required stop when signaled.
cards.memory_hook: Flagger’s stop direction must be obeyed

cards.front: Complete the rule: Portable electronic message signs give current road information.
cards.back: Portable electronic message signs give current road information such as stopped traffic, closures, delays, detours or a merging instruction, and drivers should follow their messages.
cards.memory_hook: Electronic message sign gives current guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: A slow-moving-vehicle sign calls for reduced speed.
cards.back: A slow-moving-vehicle sign calls for reduced speed and passing only when both safe and lawful.
cards.memory_hook: Slow vehicle warning does not authorize

cards.front: Complete the rule: Guide signs identify location, road and route toward.
cards.back: Guide signs identify location, road and route toward a destination; most are rectangular, while some route markers have different shapes.
cards.memory_hook: Guide sign identifies location and route

cards.front: Complete the rule: Route markers, alone or with supplementary panels, direct.
cards.back: Route markers, alone or with supplementary panels, direct travelers to specific roads using markings that vary by route type.
cards.memory_hook: Route marker identifies designated road

cards.front: Complete the rule: Hazardous-materials placards on transport vehicles, packages or containers.
cards.back: Hazardous-materials placards on transport vehicles, packages or containers use text, color and symbols to identify the presence and type of a hazard.
cards.memory_hook: Placard identifies transported hazard

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a crash involving a placarded hazardous-materials vehicle.
cards.back: At a crash involving a placarded hazardous-materials vehicle, follow responders’ evacuation instructions; without responders present, avoid the area and report it from a safe location.
cards.memory_hook: Avoid hazardous crash and follow evacuation

cards.front: Complete the rule: Toxic-exposure symptoms can be delayed, and the handbook.
cards.back: Toxic-exposure symptoms can be delayed, and the handbook directs anyone feeling ill to seek medical help.
cards.memory_hook: Delayed illness after exposure needs medical
